input.request: Deploy one smart contract, the imd/acc Stacker, on the Sepolia blockchain, then build a website for it. The Stacker's source, tests and launch.json are in github.com/khaed1/imd-acc (sepolia branch). What it does: a trading project calls credit(trader, amount); the Stacker takes that much test IMD from the project and deposits it into the live TestSIMD staking vault in the trader's name, so the trader receives staked IMD as trading cashback, and it emits a Stacked event used for points. It has no owner. It is wired to the TestIMD and TestSIMD contracts already live on Sepolia, which are reused, not redeployed. Steps: audit the imported code, adapt it to launch, an independent review, deploy the Stacker on Sepolia, then a test website against the deployed address where a connected wallet can use the faucet, stack to itself, and see its cashback, points and leaderboards.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111). Launch kind evm_contracts with one contract, the Stacker, as launch.json lists it. TestIMD 0x2b69099e59b05901faa1dd164fabf098bf831e82 and TestSIMD 0xf9e2eec3b610ec6781f7438ac5fb4bc049d81cc1 are live and reused. No owner or admin. GitHub publication is approved. Publishing the website at a public URL is approved; the platform publishes it from the release settings, so the website builders do not publish it themselves. The Stacker is deployed by the platform's launch, as usual.

draft.objective:
Launch imd/acc's updated Stacker on Sepolia from this repository's sepolia branch: deploy only the Stacker, exactly as launch.json lists it, wired to the live TestIMD and TestSIMD of launch #1129. This is the second Sepolia test run: PLEA's next version will pay its cashback through this Stacker, and mainnet will use the same code from the main branch. imd/acc pays 0.5% trading cashback to traders as staked IMD (sIMD), funded from a project's existing fees; the Stacker is the shared, ownerless funnel every project calls.

DEPLOY (Sepolia, one contract):
- Stacker(imd, sImd) with imd = 0x2b69099e59b05901faa1dd164fabf098bf831e82 (TestIMD; faucet() gives 10,000 tIMD per address per 24h) and sImd = 0xf9e2eec3b610ec6781f7438ac5fb4bc049d81cc1 (TestSIMD, a StakedIMD copy whose owner 0x4b91078b2374c956a65f7af0999cae0a935e6821 can pause it, so integrators can test their fallback). launch.json already lists exactly this. Both contracts are live; do not deploy new ones.
- src/Stacker.sol stays as it is: no owner, admin, fee, pause or upgrade; immutable IMD and SIMD; credit(trader, imdAmount) pulls IMD from msg.sender and calls sIMD.deposit(imdAmount, trader); per-project totals and the grand total on chain; event Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares), from which per-trader figures and points are computed. The constructor checks sIMD.asset() == IMD and approves the vault once, only where the vault has code, so the empty-chain rehearsal passes; test/Deployment.t.sol covers both cases.
- TestIMD and TestSIMD in test/mocks are test doubles of the live pair and are not deployed. Keep foundry.toml as it is (solc 0.8.26, cancun, 10,000 runs, bytecode_hash none).

FACTS (read on chain 2026-10-11, Sepolia block 11,889,834): TestSIMD asset() = TestIMD, owner 0x4b91…6821, not paused. Sepolia now charges far more gas for new storage and code than mainnet: with the previous Stacker, a first credit to a new trader used 0.7M–1.2M gas. This build on a mainnet fork: deploy 446,090 gas, new trader 130,313, repeat 96,113.

TESTS: forge test passes (42 tests). test/SepoliaFork.t.sol runs against the live TestIMD and TestSIMD when SEPOLIA_RPC_URL is set (a credit with its event and totals; a paused vault makes credit revert without moving anything); test/MainnetFork.t.sol runs against mainnet when ETH_RPC_URL is set. Both are skipped otherwise. Keep all of them passing.

README: once live, add this Stacker's Sepolia address as "Sepolia test run 2" in the Deployments table, next to the launch #1129 contracts.

steps.objective:
TEST PAGE for Sepolia test run 2, against the Stacker this release deploys and the live TestIMD and TestSIMD. One static page, light and dark, no horizontal scroll at 360 px. Reuse the look of the first test page (site/ in github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-1129-build-imd-acc-sepolia-test).
- Your stack (connected wallet): cashback received and points, split per project, added up from the Stacked events (this Stacker stores no per-trader totals); tsIMD held now (balanceOf); what the cashback is worth now (the shares in the wallet's Stacked events, priced with convertToAssets); earned on top (worth now minus cashback received).
- Listed projects: fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khaed1/imd-acc/main/listings/sepolia.json, an array of {address, name, fromBlock}, with a bundled copy as fallback. Points and leaderboards count only Stacked events from listed projects at or after their fromBlock, 1 point per IMD; everything else shows as "direct, no points".
- Leaderboards: top stackers by points and top listed projects by IMD stacked, with trader counts, from Stacked logs read in chunks from the Stacker's deploy block; the last ten stacks of any kind.
- Test tools: faucet (show the next allowed time from nextFaucetAt) and "stack to myself" (approve, then credit(self, x)), shown as direct.
- Contracts: the three addresses with Sepolia explorer links, the vault's open or paused state and its totals.
- Wallet: connect, switch to Sepolia (11155111), per-button pending, success and error states; send each transaction with its gas estimate times 1.3.
- RPCs in this order: https://rpc.sepolia.ethpandaops.io (it serves old logs), https://sepolia.rpc.sentio.xyz, https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com.
Check it in a real browser against live Sepolia: faucet, approve, credit, then the stack, its value and the leaderboards update.
